Proposal: keep the existing error path (cert.c testGetPublicKeyLength:4504-4508 shows Windows decodes PublicKey as an INTEGER, since an RSA key under the DH OID gives CRYPT_E_ASN1_BADTAG) and for a valid DH key decode y with X509_MULTI_BYTE_UINT, decode Algorithm.Parameters as X509_DH_PARAMETERS (47, decoder exists) and return the bit length of the prime p, falling back to bits(y) when parameters are absent. Open: no test pins p versus y; needs a Windows run to confirm before coding. Size small.

5305 did KEYID_SIGNER, BARE_CONTENT_OUT and SILENT_KEYSET, but message.c:555 still FIXMEs CRYPT_MESSAGE_ENCAPSULATED_CONTENT_OUT_FLAG and dwInnerContentType. The CRYPT_SIGN_MESSAGE_PARA page (wincrypt/ns-wincrypt-crypt_sign_message_para, HTTP 200) says the first encapsulates non-data inner content in an OCTET STRING and the second is the CMSG_* type of an input that is itself an encoded message (inner OID = the PKCS#7 content type, RFC 2315 s.7, fetched). Depends on msg.c CMSG_CMS_ENCAPSULATED_CONTENT_FLAG (see CryptMsgSignCTL work item). Work list: crypt32 CryptSignMessage.

5306 did ISSUER_CHAIN, ISSUER_NULL and the MD2/MD4 flag. SET_STRONG_PROPERTIES needs the numeric ids of CERT_SIGN_HASH_CNG_ALG_PROP_ID and CERT_ISSUER_PUB_KEY_BIT_LENGTH_PROP_ID, which no fetched page gives: stays failing until those are documented. Work list: OCSP subject and RETURN flag.

dwFlags 0 works. CMSG_CMS_ENCAPSULATED_CTL_FLAG is documented (wincrypt/nf-wincrypt-cryptmsgencodeandsignctl, HTTP 200: 'encode a CMS compatible V3 SignedData message') and CryptMsgOpenToEncode's CMSG_CMS_ENCAPSULATED_CONTENT_FLAG says non-data inner content is wrapped in an OCTET STRING; RFC 5652 (fetched) fixes the rest: eContent [0] EXPLICIT OCTET STRING, digest over its content octets, version 3 for non-data content. Work list: encapsulation in msg.c, then pass the flag through. CMSG_ENCODE_SORTED_CTL_FLAG/HASHED_SUBJECT_IDENTIFIER_FLAG stay failing: the sorted-CTL extension layout is not in any fetched page.

Same as CryptMsgEncodeAndSignCTL: CMSG_CMS_ENCAPSULATED_CTL_FLAG is documented (wincrypt/nf-wincrypt-cryptmsgsignctl, HTTP 200) and is CryptMsgOpenToEncode's CMSG_CMS_ENCAPSULATED_CONTENT_FLAG with szOID_CTL as inner type; encoding rules from RFC 5652 sections 5.1-5.2 (fetched). Currently msg.c:4178 fails any non-zero flag. Work list: crypt32 CryptMsgSignCTL.

5308 did DSA v1 private and V2 blobs. The function as a whole is not done: LEGACY_DH_PRIVATE_BLOB and LEGACY_DH_PUBLIC_BLOB (listed on bcrypt/nf-bcrypt-bcryptexportkey, HTTP 200) are not exported or imported, and their layouts are documented (win32 SecCrypto/diffie-hellman-version-3-private-key-blobs.md and ...public-key-blobs.md, fetched: BLOBHEADER, DHPRIVKEY_VER3, P Q G J Y X little-endian).
